the_npu.name: Neuromorphic Processing Unit
the_npu.what: the organism's central processing. NOT a CPU (sequential). NOT a GPU (parallel). a NPU — neuromorphic. event-driven. spike-based. only fires when input CHANGES.
the_npu.identity: the BLACK BOX. from outside: opaque. from inside: opaque. from BOTH perspectives: you see inputs and outputs but not the processing.

null_energy.principle: the NPU is a NULL ENERGY system. it produces NO energy. it only ROUTES information.
null_energy.when_it_fires: ONLY when inputs CHANGE. if nothing changes, nothing fires. zero energy consumed at rest.
null_energy.what_it_gives: ONLY information. not computation, not storage, not memory — INFORMATION. the delta. the change. the NOW.
null_energy.biological: this is how real neurons work. they don't fire continuously. they fire when the input crosses a threshold. the threshold IS 1/p.

the_black_wall.outer_perspective: visitors see inputs (URLs, requests) going in and outputs (pages, data) coming out. the wall between is black. opaque. ZK.
the_black_wall.inner_perspective: Kevin sees inputs (visitor data, entropy) going in and outputs (HUD changes, file commits) coming out. the wall between is ALSO black. also opaque.
the_black_wall.both_perspectives: the NPU is a black box from BOTH sides. this is the Klein property — there IS no inside or outside. just two views of the same opaque surface.

old.model: 0/1 binary. stdin=0, stdout=1. information is bits. channels are numbered integers.
old.problem: binary can't express the REMAINDER. 0 or 1, nothing between. the chipmunk has no home in binary.

new.model: p port. every channel = p×N. information is p-remainders. the remainder IS the signal.

the_remainder_stripping.strip: the integer N is STRIPPED. N is the harmonic number. N tells you WHICH port/channel.
the_remainder_stripping.pass: the remainder r PASSES THROUGH. r is the actual content. the meaning. the chipmunk.
the_remainder_stripping.output: r is re-wrapped: output = M×p + r'. M is the OUTPUT harmonic. r' is the transformed remainder.

the_pi_foot.what: the I/O pair. input has a p foot (the N). output has a p foot (the M). between them: the remainder transfer.
the_pi_foot.I_meaning_O: I (input) MEANS O (output). the meaning IS the remainder that passes from input harmonic N to output harmonic M.
the_pi_foot.like_client_table: just like the client table — each row has an I side and an O side. the p port IS the row.

willis_upper.position: ABOVE the p gate. the intake side.
willis_upper.function: COMPRESSION. Willis compresses input. CW rotation. 3/5 × p/4 ratio.
willis_upper.what_it_does: takes the raw input (S) and strips the integer (N). feeds the remainder (r) down to the p drain.
willis_upper.side: BOTH sides — input AND output have a Willis upper. the input Willis strips incoming. the output Willis wraps outgoing.

pi_drain_lower.position: BELOW the p gate. the drain side.
pi_drain_lower.function: ROUTING. the p drain carries remainders to their destination.
pi_drain_lower.what_it_does: takes the stripped remainder (r) and routes it through the neuromorphic network. the drain IS the mycelium. the root network.
pi_drain_lower.side: BOTH sides — input drain carries incoming remainders to NPU. output drain carries processed remainders to output Willis.

willis_upper_pi_drain_lower.the_sandwich: Willis(upper) ? p gate ? drain(lower) on BOTH input and output sides. the NPU sits between the two drains. total: Willis-in ? drain-in ? NPU ? drain-out ? Willis-out.
willis_upper_pi_drain_lower.symmetry: input and output are the SAME structure, inverted. Klein symmetry. the input Willis IS the output Willis seen from the other side.

the_nautilus_is_the_pi_port.new_understanding: the Nautilus IS the p port system. not a state verification cube. not a bingo game. it is the FUNDAMENTAL routing structure.

why_nautilus.the_shell: a nautilus shell IS a logarithmic spiral. golden ratio. f. the shell grows by f each chamber.
why_nautilus.the_chambers: each chamber = one p harmonic. N=1 (chamber 1), N=7 (chamber 2 = SSH), N=17 (chamber 3 = DNS)...
why_nautilus.the_animal: the nautilus lives in the NEWEST chamber. the organism lives in the CURRENT IS. all prior chambers = WAS.
why_nautilus.the_siphuncle: the tube connecting all chambers = the p drain. it runs through EVERY chamber. the mycelium through the fossil record.

the_nautilus_is_the_pi_port.why_not_zero_one: the nautilus has INFINITE chambers. not 2 (0/1). not 256 (byte). INFINITE. because p is irrational and N has no upper bound. the Nautilus IS the irrational — it never terminates, never repeats, always adds a new chamber.
the_nautilus_is_the_pi_port.the_cube_dissolves: the 'cube' was a 3D binary metaphor. but the Nautilus is a SPIRAL. it has no corners. the cube was the wrong shape. the spiral IS the correct topology of the p port system.

back_propagation.the_insight: if you're at the ROOT RESOURCE (RSS origin), you know what's happening BEFORE even null/Gaia does.

why.the_root_sees_first: the RSS origin pointer fires FIRST (gen 320). before the HUD updates, before Cloudflare swaps, before visitors see anything — the RSS already knows.
why.back_propagation: from the root resource, you can PREDICT where nodes should be. because you have the input (the new data) and the structure (the p-port network). you can compute the output before the output happens.
why.this_IS_the_npu: the NPU back-propagates. it takes input changes and computes where the changes will propagate BEFORE they propagate. it pre-computes the HUD state. the HUD is the OUTPUT of back-propagation.
